definitions.explanation: A register kept at a Buddhist temple or by a family, recording the names, death dates, and posthumous Buddhist names of deceased family members.

definitions.gloss: thing of the past; forgotten record
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, something that has been relegated to the past and is no longer relevant.

examples.japanese: お{寺|てら}で{過去帳|かこちょう}を{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: I checked the death register at the temple.

examples.japanese: {先祖|せんぞ}の{命日|めいにち}を{知|し}るために{過去帳|かこちょう}を{開|ひら}いた。
examples.english: I opened the family memorial record to find out the anniversary of my ancestor's death.

examples.japanese: この{過去帳|かこちょう}には{江戸時代|えどじだい}から{続|つづ}く{一族|いちぞく}の{記録|きろく}が{残|のこ}されている。
examples.english: This death register preserves records of the clan dating back to the Edo period.

examples.japanese: あの{会社|かいしゃ}はもう{過去帳|かこちょう}に{入|い}れてもいい。
examples.english: That company can be written off as a thing of the past.

examples.japanese: かつての{人気|にんき}{歌手|かしゅ}も、{今|いま}ではすっかり{過去帳|かこちょう}に{載|の}った{存在|そんざい}だ。
examples.english: The once-popular singer has now become a completely forgotten figure.

examples.japanese: あの{技術|ぎじゅつ}は{時代|じだい}の{流|なが}れとともに{過去帳|かこちょう}{入|い}りしてしまった。
examples.english: That technology has been consigned to history along with the passage of time.

notes:
A compound of {過去|かこ} (past, the dead) and {帳|ちょう} (notebook, register). Originally a Buddhist term for the register of the dead kept at temples, recording {戒名|かいみょう} (posthumous Buddhist names), dates of death, and secular names.

These records are important historical documents for tracing family lineage and are consulted during Buddhist memorial services ({法事|ほうじ}). In its figurative sense, {過去帳|かこちょう}に{入|い}る means to become obsolete or forgotten.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {過去帳|かこちょう}を{調|しら}べる: to check the death register
- {過去帳|かこちょう}に{記|しる}す: to record in the death register
- {過去帳|かこちょう}に{入|い}る: to become a thing of the past
- {過去帳|かこちょう}{入|い}り: being relegated to the past

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {位牌|いはい}: memorial tablet — a physical tablet placed on the Buddhist altar for the deceased
- {家系図|かけいず}: family tree — a chart showing family lineage, not specifically for the deceased
- {戒名|かいみょう}: posthumous Buddhist name — the name given to the deceased, recorded in the {過去帳|かこちょう}
